blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and his family avoided the usual Undas crowd when they visited the tomb of his father, former President Ferdinand E. Marcos Sr. at the Libingan ng mga Bayani in Taguig City. The Presidential Communications Office (PCO) on Sunday said Marcos made a private visit to his father’s gravesite on Oct. 30. He was accompanied by his mother, former First Lady Imelda R. Marcos, his sister Irene Marcos-Araneta, and close family members and friends.
